description.narrative: (Cambodia): .The USAID Greening Prey Lang activity works to protect Cambodia's largest designated conservation area and help the local people who depend on it for their livelihoods. The activity improves forest management, promotes resilient and low-emissions development, and advocates for improved governance of the Prey Lang extended landscape. The activity provides technical assistance for sustainable landscape management and biodiversity conservation to beneficiaries who depend on the area's ecological services, such as water, biodiversity, and food. It works to increase the capacity of relevant stakeholders to assess and address sustainable landscape issues. In addition, this activity supports community-based organizations, private sector, and other stakeholders to better manage Protected Areas and Community Forests to ultimately reduce environmental crimes, such as land encroachment, illegal logging, and wildlife poaching. In addition, the activity improves market linkages for non-timber forest products and eco-tourism...The activity falls under the Administration's priority to promote climate security and resilience, modernize information, and champion equity and inclusion for all. The activity also supports the Indo-Pacific Framework and contributes to Mission Objective 1 (CDCS DO1) "Inclusive and Sustainable Economic Growth Broadened.".
